features.name: area_per_room
features.description: Calculates the average square meters per room, providing a measure of spaciousness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps tree models split on property density and spaciousness, which often correlates with property value.

features.name: is_large_apartment
features.description: Boolean indicator for properties larger than 80 square meters.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct binary split for tree models to isolate larger, potentially premium properties.

features.name: floor_category
features.description: Ordinal bucketing of the floor number into basement/ground (0), low (1), mid (2), and high (3).
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups floors into meaningful categories, reducing the number of splits needed by the tree to capture floor-level effects.

features.name: room_area_interaction
features.description: Nonlinear interaction between the number of rooms and the total area.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes a multiplicative relationship between size and room count that might be complex for a tree to approximate with orthogonal splits.

features.name: location_premium_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of the location's desirability based on the location ID and its typical real estate market characteristics.
features.expected_model_benefit: Injects domain knowledge about neighborhood quality that raw location IDs cannot convey linearly.

features.name: title_length_bucket
features.description: Categorizes the title feature (likely length or encoded complexity) into short (0), medium (1), and long (2).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates an ordinal feature from title metadata, allowing the tree to easily split on listing descriptiveness.

features.name: is_ground_or_basement
features.description: Binary indicator for properties located on the ground floor or in the basement.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates properties that often have distinct pricing dynamics due to accessibility, security, or natural light.

features.name: scraped_at_seasonality
features.description: Approximates a seasonal or monthly cyclical component from the scraped_at timestamp.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the model capture cyclical market trends or listing behaviors over the year.

features.name: area_sqm_log
features.description: Logarithmic transformation of the area in square meters.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the long tail of property sizes, making it easier for the tree to find stable splits in the upper range.

features.name: high_floor_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for properties located above the 10th floor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct split for high-rise apartments, which often carry a premium for views or suffer penalties for elevator dependency.

features.name: property_type_inference
features.description: Infers the likely property type (e.g., studio, penthouse, standard apartment) based on the combination of rooms, area, and floor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a high-level categorical grouping that synthesizes multiple raw features into a single, highly predictive concept.

features.name: relative_size_for_rooms
features.description: Measures how much larger or smaller the property is compared to a baseline expectation of 25 sqm per room.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights unusually cramped or unusually spacious properties for their room count, offering a strong signal for property quality.
